changelog:
白い熊 店 4.8.4+017
• 保存復元 automation contract v2: this app now answers automation out of the box — the master switch defaults to on and “Use authorization token?” defaults to off, because a pasted secret cannot survive a wipe
• A token sent while none is being asked for is ignored, never refused
• New: 白い熊 応用管理 can back this app up with its data and restore it onto a clean phone, through a door that checks the caller's exact package name, its uid and its pinned signing certificate
• The archive moves through a file descriptor the caller opened, not a path — so it lands inside 応用管理's encrypted, checksummed backup rather than beside it
• Your Google account is still never exported, and the app now says so on the backup row: a restored install comes back fully configured but signed out
• An import now flushes both settings stores to disk before reporting success, so a restore can no longer report success over data that never got written
• The token row is hidden — and no token generated — unless you actually ask for one
